resources.string: Done: %1$d of %2$d. You can skip any step.
Where your money is: a card, cash or savings. Start with one.
Any one, even a coffee. Tap “+”.
How much you are happy to spend on groceries a month. You can change it.
It is easier together. Or later.
Tap the card to flip it: the back has the most useful things of the month.
No transactions yet. Tap “+” to add the first one.
An account is where your money sits. The balance adds up by itself.
A category is what the money went on. The ready-made ones will do; add your own later.
A limit is how much you can spend on a category in a month. A guide, not a ban.
Here you see where the money goes. The more entries, the clearer the picture.
A tag is a coloured label on a transaction, like “holiday” or “gifts”.
Easier together: entries from both phones come together in one place.
